judgments.rationale: The evidence packet directly supports the contrast. CliVER is described as a scientific claim verification system, ECE as a framework that extracts fine-grained claims and scores claim-evidence support plus citation quality, and RefLens as an evidence-grounded citation verification system with citation-level outputs. By contrast, EvoScientist is evaluated on idea quality and code execution success, Autonomous Research Loops on research artifact quality and observed failure modes, and Heuresis on quality/diversity/novelty plus execution-time fabrications.
